{{Quote|Hey, you're late! Which one of you is Salld, and what's with the entourage? Our deal was passage to Cularin for one.|Gern Zott, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="Quarters">{{LivingForce|Blinking Eyes: Quarters}}</ref>}}
'''Gern Zott''', also known by the nickname '''Gerzott''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[near-Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Gott operated from the modified [[YT-1760 small transport/Legends|YT-1760 transport]] ''[[The Panada's Kiss]]'', and aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] he carried a hollow [[Battle droid/Legends|enforcer droid]] shell called [[N4]], which he rigged to a small power supply to give the illusion that the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was fully-functional. Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Zott was hired by the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Krol-Pek]] to transport the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Salld Nrump]]&mdash;who was on the run from [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] hired by the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group&mdash;from the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Varna Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] to the nearby world [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. However, Nrump was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the mercenaries and the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who were investigating his death, arrived at Zott's berth in [[hangar 12C]] and negotiated with Zott to be transported to Cularin in Nrump's place. The hangar was subsequently attacked by the mercenaries, and Zott and the agents fled aboard ''The Panada's Kiss''. The vessel headed for Cularin and after a five hour journey, the starship arrived on the world and Zott rendezvoused with Krol-Pek.

==Personality of traits==
Gern Zott was of average height and he had bright purple eyes, yellow-brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that was tied into a single braid, and a long scar that ran down the length of his face. Over the years, Zott's name was shortened by those around hin to "Gerzott," and he was quick to adopt and perpetuate the use of the nickname, because he believed that it gave him a degree of anonymity.
